environment: Local isolated PostgreSQL sandbox; sequential LiveView tests with collaborative record and operations fixtures

method.baseline: The same five burst scenarios with the parent UserAuth hook, before coalescing. Cost equality assertions were disabled for this baseline diagnostic only; behavior assertions remained enabled.
method.candidate: RefreshCoalescingLiveTest with coalescing enabled and all assertions enabled.
method.window: Settle preceding messages with sys.get_state; suspend the LiveView, enqueue the named burst, resume it within QueryProbe scope all, then render as the completion barrier.
method.counts: All observed SQL statements, including transaction and authorization setup; rows are all returned rows, not distinct business records.
method.capture: Aggregate counters only; no SQL parameters or protected content are retained.

correctness: Each surviving callback retains current session and projection authorization.
Mixed permission and record invalidations remove revoked drafts and retain unrelated authorized drafts.
Delivery outcomes refresh even when the ticket revision is unchanged.
Presence retains its lightweight projection without history or document queries.
Commands, access revocation, periodic revalidation, unrelated records and unrelated tenants are not consumed.
Notifications arriving during SQL cause another current projection after the in-flight read.
limitations: The bursts are deliberately queued to measure coalescing; sequential notification costs remain unchanged.
Only staff record and process workspaces participate; upstream publication deduplication remains pending.
The cap bounds consumed messages, not scanning cost across unrelated mailbox entries.
Local statement counts are not hosted latency or concurrency capacity estimates.
Complete deferred-cycle and connection-occupancy measurement remains pending.
